segments.name: Lighting-related services
products: enterprise-grade LED lighting and energy products
segments.description: Sells lighting-related services and products, including retrofit projects and enterprise-grade LED lighting, to its customers.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment which is the sale of lighting-related services and products.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for lighting systems that replace their existing lighting fixtures in retrofit projects, and for finished lighting products delivered to their location.
revenueModel.evidence: The retrofit projects generated revenue by selling its lighting systems as replacements for its customers' existing lighting fixtures.

changes.text: In 2025 the Group sold its subsidiary Grand Alliance International Limited (GAI) to Mr. Michael Lau.
changes.evidence: On March 25, 2025, EGHL transferred all of the issued and outstanding shares of its subsidiary, Grand Alliance International Limited ("GAI"), to Mr. Michael Lau for consideration of HKD$1.00
